text: やまみち　ひさしぶりに　あるいて　ひんけつ　ぎみ　なの

structure.jp: やまみち　ひさしぶりに　あるいて
structure.en: I walked a mountain path for the first time in ages, and

structure.jp: ひんけつ　ぎみ　なの

patterns.name: 〜ぎみ
patterns.explanation: ぎみ after a word means 'a touch of' or 'feeling slightly'. ひんけつ　ぎみ = 'a bit anemic'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this part to the next one, here giving the reason for it. あるいて = 'I walked, and so'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: なの is the soft, feminine form of なのだ, used when explaining your situation. ぎみ　なの = 'it's that I'm feeling a bit that way'.
